comparison.objective: PR-2103 opens a robot vacuum brush door by releasing two catches; the candidate adjusts a robot gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2103 tests simultaneous dual-button compression followed by hinged-door lifting while stabilizing the appliance; the candidate tests two-tool screw/nut coordination.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2103 requires the door open at least 80°, appliance in place, hands clear, and still; the candidate requires a locked target angle and repeat-cycle retention.
comparison.reason: Opening a dual-catch access door is not an adjustable-setting or locknut-retention task.
